title: Markets dashboard
summary: A markets dashboard on public exchange feeds, with no server of its own: trades, prices and alerts are aggregated in your tab. It's built native, native with workers and on Isoloop, in React and in Preact, at three sizes. A second build combines two teams' parts, one shipped separately and loaded at run time, and an interactive page adds widgets that the balancer places. Two of its topics are tools a coding agent can call in development.
try: Switch the size to Heavy and compare Native and Isoloop: watch the frame rate, and how fast the Type here box answers.
The live page starts in `own`: block a chart and only it stalls. In `matched` a block stalls every widget while the data keeps flowing, and in `one` everything stalls until the block ends.
Crash a widget: on the native builds its error boundary keeps it down until a reload; on Isoloop it restarts on its own.
On the two-team build, block the Preact team's alerts panel: in `teams` the React widgets keep updating; in `matched` they stall.
Open the interactive page, add widgets from the drawer, and watch the balancer place them.
On the Isoloop build, add `?devtools=1` to the address and open the devtools panel in the corner (or press Alt+Shift+D): the isolates, the bus's topics and a live log of the records.

blocks.heading: Normal and Heavy
findings: At Heavy both native builds fill the main thread and drop about a third of their frames; Isoloop keeps every frame and types in 41 ms against 156 ms.
At Normal every build keeps every frame on Chromium, and Isoloop types 4–7 ms slower.
It costs +4 to +29 points of CPU across threads, +33 to +52 MB after GC and 0.1–0.2 s more to first data.
blocks.caption: Native + workers against Isoloop matched (one pool for the widgets: the placement measured, not the live page's default, own), on the desktop machine (4 cores fixed at 2.0 GHz), Chromium, 5 interleaved rounds, measured at markets-v0.3.0, November 2026.

rows.label: Back to normal after a 3 s block

blocks.firefox: Firefox: at Normal the native builds drop 5–10 frames and Isoloop 0–1, and Isoloop types 16–44 ms faster; first data is 0.4–0.5 s later.
notes: Δ is the median of the gaps measured in each round, so it can differ from the difference of the two medians.
Recovery is close to a tie: markets sets no kill timeout, so every build waits out the full block.

blocks.heading: Two teams
findings: When the Preact team's alerts panel blocks for 3 s, the React team's widgets get none of their updates on native + workers or in `matched`, where they share the panel's pool; with a pool per team (`teams`) they keep 94% of their updates at Heavy (98% at Normal).
When the panel crashes, native's error boundary keeps it down until a reload; Isoloop brings it back in 1.3–1.4 s.
Isoloop loads 61 KB more JavaScript, gzipped, and costs +49 MB after GC and +29 points of CPU at Heavy.
